name: Aereni Expertise
entriesHtml:
Growing up in Aerenal, you spent decades developing your talent with one particular skill. You gain the following benefits.

Skill Proficiency.

You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Expertise.

You gain Expertise|XPHB with the skill you selected for this feat.
description:

**Expertise**

You gain Expertise|XPHB with the skill you selected for this feat.

name: Aereni Half-Life
entriesHtml:
You've undergone rituals that bind you to Irian and the Undying Court. Many who undergo this process have a desiccated appearance, similar to a mummy; it's up to you to decide whether you are affected in this way. Regardless of your appearance, you gain the following benefits.

Deathless.

You have Advantage|XPHB on Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws.

Resistance.

You have Resistance|XPHB to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

Radiant Focus.

If you cast a spell that deals Necrotic damage, you can choose to have it inflict Radiant damage instead.

name: Aquatic Adaptation
entriesHtml:
You are able to live underwater. This may be a natural feature of your character if you're playing a Malenti or an Elf from Valraea, or it could be the result of arcane transmutation or a divine blessing. Whatever the origin of this gift, you gain the following benefits.

Amphibious.

You can breathe underwater. If you possess the Limited Amphibiousness trait in addition to this feat, this eliminates your dependence on water.

Athletic Build.

You gain proficiency in the Athletics skill.

Natural Swimmer.

You have a Swim Speed|XPHB equal to your Speed|XPHB.

name: Changeling Metamorphosis
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Hardened Skin.

You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class|XPHB.

Metamorphosis.

When you use your Shape-Shifter trait, you may choose one of the following options. You gain the benefits of the chosen option until you use your Shape-Shifter trait again.

Aquatic Adaptation.

You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed|XPHB equal to your Speed|XPHB.

Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Natural Weapons.

You grow claws (Slashing), fangs (Piercing), horns (Piercing), or hooves (Bludgeoning). When you use your Unarmed Strike|XPHB to deal damage with that new growth, it deals 1d6 damage of the type in parentheses instead of dealing the normal damage for your Unarmed Strike|XPHB, and you can choose to use your Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength.

name: Envoy Specialist
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Envoy Competence.

You gain proficiency with one tool of your choice.

Integrated Tool.

Choose one tool you are proficient with. You have a working model of this tool integrated into your body, which can't be removed. As long as you have a hand free, you can make use of the integrated tool.

Innate Talent.

When you make an ability check with the integrated tool, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

name: Focused Personas
entriesHtml:
You've developed personas that help you focus your talents. Work with your DM to define two unique personas—identities with distinct appearances and personalities. You gain the following benefits.

Adept Persona.

Choose a tool and define a persona associated with it. Whenever you use your Shape-Shifter trait to assume the persona, you gain proficiency with the chosen tool and when you make an ability check with the chosen tool, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

Expert Persona.

Choose a skill you are proficient in and define a different persona associated with it. Whenever you use your Shape-Shifter trait to assume the persona, you gain Expertise|XPHB in the chosen skill.

Skin Cant.

You are fluent in Skin Cant|ExploringEberron24, a language used by the Changeling Travelers.

name: Juggernaut Plating
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Resilient Armor.

While you remain alive, armor you have donned can't be targeted by any effect (such as the Heat Metal spell or the antennae of a rust monster) against your will.

Adamantine Body.

Any Critical Hit|XPHB against you becomes a normal hit.

name: Khesh'dar Training
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Swift and Silent.

You gain proficiency in the Stealth skill.

Master of Shadows.

You gain Expertise|XPHB with the Stealth skill.

Fade Away.

When you take the Hide action, the DC for a successful check is reduced to 10. All other restrictions still apply.

name: Quori Bond
entriesHtml:
You possess a particularly strong bond with your quori spirit. You gain the following benefits.

Quori Lineage.

Choose a lineage from the Quori Lineages table. Your choice affects the Skill and Spell sections detailed below.

QuoriSkillSpell
Du'uloraIntimidationCrown of Madness
HashataqPersuasionSuggestion
KalaraqPerceptionMind Spike
TsucoraIntimidationShatter*

* when cast using this feat, Shatter deals Psychic damage

Skill.

When you make an ability check with the skill associated with your quori lineage, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

Spell.

You always have the spell associated with your quori lineage prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Superior Shifting
entriesHtml:
You have a potent connection to the beast within, strengthening your body and your ability to shift. You gain the following benefits.

Shifting Endurance.

At the start of your turn, you can use your Shifting trait (no action required). The transformation now lasts 10 minutes.

Shifter Recovery.

You can use your Shifting trait one additional time. You regain 1 expended use when you finish a Short Rest|XPHB, and all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Thoughtsinger
entriesHtml:
You have honed your telepathic abilities, allowing you to link to and guide your companions as a united group. You gain the following benefits.

Superior Telepathy.

The telepathy granted by your Mind Link trait has a range of 120 feet or 10 times your level, whichever is higher.

Thoughtsong.

When you use your Mind Link trait to grant a creature the ability to speak to you telepathically, you form a mental connection with that individual. When you communicate telepathically, you may choose to send the message to all creatures you currently have a mental connection to. You may also allow those creatures to speak telepathically with one another. These effects last for as long as the Mind Link remains in effect.

Telepathic Aid.

If you can speak telepathically to an ally using your Mind Link trait, you can take the Help action to aid them in attacking a creature, even if you are more than 5 feet away from them.

name: Uul Dhakaan
prerequisite: Dhakaani Ghaal'dar (Hobgoblin) or Dhakaani Golin'dar (Goblin) or Dhakaani Guul'dar (Bugbear)
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Dreamwalker.

You remain fully lucid when you dream and when you wake, you clearly remember everything that transpired.

Mentor in the Uul.

There is a spirit in the Uul Dhakaan that serves as your mentor. Work with your DM to develop the identity of this spirit; they could be the memory of an ancestor or fallen hero, or a living uul'kala bard. Whenever you finish a Long Rest|XPHB, there's a chance you'll receive a vision, a mission, or a clue about your current situation.

Shielded by Dreams.

You have Resistance|XPHB to Psychic damage.
